purpose: Separate permission to procure from permission to activate production.

procurementEntryCriteria.plainLanguage: The evidence rules are visible and unchanged.
procurementEntryCriteria.machineCheck: Evidence status and schema endpoints return HTTP 200 and match the required trust contract.

procurementEntryCriteria.plainLanguage: The existing control plane and providers are reachable.
procurementEntryCriteria.machineCheck: G0 is PASS and provider telemetry is ready.

procurementEntryCriteria.plainLanguage: A buyer, budget owner, and acceptance date are named.

procurementBundles.name: Managed foundation
procurementBundles.plainLanguage: Buy one shared data service, secure secret storage, and a signed image registry.
deliverables: Independent production credentials with a named rotation owner
One OCI registry supporting digest-pinned signed images and SBOMs

procurementBundles.name: Worker capacity
procurementBundles.plainLanguage: Buy one controlled Linux worker for acceptance; add a second before availability is claimed.
deliverables: A second worker before high-availability or production availability claims

procurementBundles.name: Acceptance and operations
procurementBundles.plainLanguage: Fund one acceptance window, named operators, monitoring, rollback, and recovery proof.
deliverables: A bounded health.echo canary and signed receipt
Monitoring, rollback evidence, and one recovery exercise
